about_the_game:
Experience the thunderous intensity of Terminator: Dark Fate - Defiance through the thrilling music by composer Eduard "EDLISE" Lisin.
Lisin's music immerses players in the epic confrontations between man and machine, with 34 tunes that perfectly capture the essence of the Terminator: Dark Fate Universe.
